🔒 Your enquiry form doesn’t need a diagnosis.

Some clinic websites ask for much more than they need: medical history, report uploads, ID numbers. Every extra field is one more reason for a worried patient to stop filling it in, and one more piece of sensitive information sitting in an inbox or a spreadsheet.

Ask for three things:
1️⃣ Name
2️⃣ Phone or WhatsApp number
3️⃣ A good time to call

Leave out:
✖️ Medical history or symptoms in detail
✖️ Report uploads
✖️ Aadhaar or other ID numbers

✅ Collect what you need to call back. Talk about the rest in person, where it belongs.

Our founder, Jaidev Jethi, studied cybersecurity in Canada before starting CareInflow. Collect less, protect more is a habit from that work.
